g.text: Main board interface · reset and boot

g.desc: Main board interface · reset and boot

g.text: Base board powers MCP23017 and provides the I²C pull-ups.

g.desc: Base board powers MCP23017 and provides the I²C pull-ups.

g.text: Nexperia Ioff buffers prevent backfeed between independent 3.3V rails. DIR defaults LOW.

g.desc: Nexperia Ioff buffers prevent backfeed between independent 3.3V rails. DIR defaults LOW.

g.text: Keep the isolated ground separate across the stack.

g.desc: Keep the isolated ground separate across the stack.

g.text: RS-485 · ADM2687E · UART1 / GPIO8 TX, GPIO47 RX, GPIO48 DIR

g.desc: RS-485 · ADM2687E · UART1 / GPIO8 TX, GPIO47 RX, GPIO48 DIR

g.text: REF2 pins 5/8: local GND. FIELD TVS uses GND_ISO only.

g.desc: REF2 pins 5/8: local GND. FIELD TVS uses GND_ISO only.

g.text: SRDA REF1 pins 2/3: local floating node; never connect to supply.

g.desc: SRDA REF1 pins 2/3: local floating node; never connect to supply.

g.text: Additional isolated DATA ports · GPIO17 / GPIO18

g.desc: Additional isolated DATA ports · GPIO17 / GPIO18

g.text: TVS on connector side; 100R then isolator + 4.7k pull-up.

g.desc: TVS on connector side; 100R then isolator + 4.7k pull-up.

g.text: Assert reset for ≥1 ms. Wait ≥2 ms before SPI.

g.desc: Assert reset for ≥1 ms. Wait ≥2 ms before SPI.

g.text: Power from base board. USB VBUS used only for sensing.

g.desc: Power from base board. USB VBUS used only for sensing.

g.text: Sensor power · isolated 5 V and 3.3 V

g.desc: Sensor power · isolated 5 V and 3.3 V

g.text: Budget: main 3.3 V 890 mA; module output rated 1 A.

g.desc: Budget: main 3.3 V 890 mA; module output rated 1 A.

g.text: Keep input / output decoupling close to the R-78K module.

g.desc: Keep input / output decoupling close to the R-78K module.

g.text: Independent 12 V main and RS-485 branches; 5 V feeds TMR.

g.desc: Independent 12 V main and RS-485 branches; 5 V feeds TMR.

g.text: The field bus and base-board I²C use separate GPIO pairs.

g.desc: The field bus and base-board I²C use separate GPIO pairs.

g.text: Additional isolated DATA ports · GPIO1 / GPIO2

g.desc: Additional isolated DATA ports · GPIO1 / GPIO2

g.text: W5500 Lite · RJ45 toward DI terminals

g.desc: W5500 Lite · RJ45 toward DI terminals

g.text: ADM2687E pin10 VISOOUT feeds pin15 VISOIN only; never parallel with sensor 3V3_ISO.

g.desc: ADM2687E pin10 VISOOUT feeds pin15 VISOIN only; never parallel with sensor 3V3_ISO.

g.text: GND2 shares GND_ISO. Terminal 5V comes from TMR. Fit TERM only at a bus end.

g.desc: GND2 shares GND_ISO. Terminal 5V comes from TMR. Fit TERM only at a bus end.

g.text: Use 3-wire, externally powered sensors and open-drain GPIO.

g.desc: Use 3-wire, externally powered sensors and open-drain GPIO.

g.text: Main power · protected 12 V to 3.3 V / 1 A

g.desc: Main power · protected 12 V to 3.3 V / 1 A

g.text: LED anodes use NET / PWR / STATUS / ALARM, all cathodes use GND.

g.desc: LED anodes use NET / PWR / STATUS / ALARM, all cathodes use GND.

g.text: GPIO44 is DATA8; keep UART0 RX disabled.

g.desc: GPIO44 is DATA8; keep UART0 RX disabled.

g.text: PWR follows 3.3 V. Other LEDs are active LOW at GPIO7 / 15 / 16.

g.desc: PWR follows 3.3 V. Other LEDs are active LOW at GPIO7 / 15 / 16.

g.text: Native USB serial/JTAG · no external JTAG on GPIO39–42

g.desc: Native USB serial/JTAG · no external JTAG on GPIO39–42

g.text: 0x68; main I²C. CR1220 primary cell; no charger.

g.desc: 0x68; main I²C. CR1220 primary cell; no charger.
